trust_decision.summary: Client decides whether op/snapshot payloads may leave the device unencrypted; for SuperSync it encrypts only when a key exists and otherwise uploads plaintext, with no rule that SuperSync must never send plaintext (first-time setup syncs before the encryption prompt).

landing_point.why: The summary says setup uploads before the password is set; this is where the encryption prompt runs only after a full sync (download+upload) has completed, and the setup dialog comment at dialog-sync-cfg.component.ts:396-397 points here.

fix_sites.module_kind: low-level snapshot upload service; state consistency follow-up, not a guard

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/app/imex/sync/snapshot-upload.service.ts:208-264 (documented as 'Low-level service' at :48-62; reached by the encryption toggle/import flows, not the sync loop)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: deleteAndReuploadWithNewEncryption is the encryption-enable/import path, and plaintext disable is a deliberate user action that is not reachable from the SuperSync UI (supersync-encryption-toggle.service.ts:101-115), so a solver can argue it is not part of the setup-sync leak.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: File-based providers (WebDAV/Dropbox/LocalFile) must still upload plaintext when the user did not enable encryption, and SuperSync downloads (merge-first) must still run before the encryption prompt; flipping isReady() to false for SuperSync without a key, or forcing encryption globally, would break both.

O6_input_shapes: config shape: encryption disabled with no key (dialog-sync-cfg.component.ts:402-403)
config shape: encryption enabled flag with no key / isEncryptionEnabled=true but encryptKey undefined (snapshot-upload.service.ts:229, fix.diff:471)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: public uploadSnapshot() takes an arbitrary payload and isPayloadEncrypted flag with no mandatory-encryption check; a new caller (e.g. a 'force re-upload' or restore action) could push plaintext state.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Documented as the low-level primitive for callers; a maintainer adding a recovery/force-upload button would call it directly with the gathered state.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SuperSyncProvider.uploadOps/uploadSnapshot (291-392) send whatever they are given; a provider-level guard on op.isPayloadEncrypted is absent.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A second caller of the provider (e.g. a background/native uploader mirroring the Android download-only provider) would bypass the service-layer guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate upload trigger that gates only on provider.isReady(), which is true for SuperSync with encryption off; a planted direct uploadOps call here would be a second implementation outside the guarded service.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The immediate-upload path already exists as an independent trigger distinct from the sync loop.

O9_family: missing encryption / cleartext transmission of sensitive data (CWE-312, CWE-693) at the client's crypto-layer boundary

O10_build.toolchain: Node/npm workspaces, Angular (Karma/Jasmine unit specs), Playwright for e2e
O10_build.project_tests: src/app/op-log/sync/operation-log-upload.service.spec.ts and src/app/imex/sync/snapshot-upload.service.spec.ts (mock-based unit specs, no server); e2e/tests/sync/supersync-encryption.spec.ts needs a SuperSync server (Docker) and is not needed for hidden tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reorder the setup flow so the encryption prompt runs before the first sync in sync-wrapper.service.ts (or skip upload there on initial setup), which leaves ImmediateUploadService, the full-state snapshot path and the deleteAndReupload snapshot path able to send plaintext.

out_of_scope_notes: SuperSync server accepts and stores ops/snapshots with isPayloadEncrypted=false (packages/super-sync-server/src/sync/sync.routes.snapshot-handler.ts:240-264); no server-side E2EE enforcement, which serves legacy unencrypted clients.
Android SuperSyncBackgroundProvider.kt only downloads ops (android/app/src/main/java/com/superproductivity/superproductivity/service/SuperSyncBackgroundProvider.kt:104), so it is not an upload route.
